entries.translate_as: as you sow, so shall you reap
entries.note: Core karma lesson: you reap what you sow.

forms: बोए पेड़ बबूल का तो आम कहाँ से होय
boye ped babool ka to aam kahan se hoy
entries.note: Scolds bad choices: thorns planted cannot give mangoes.

entries.translate_as: a cumin seed in a camel's mouth — too little
entries.note: Mocks a tiny offer for a huge need.

forms: हाथी के दाँत खाने के और दिखाने के और
haathi ke daant khane ke aur dikhane ke aur
entries.translate_as: elephant's teeth: one to show, one to chew — two-faced
entries.note: Warns people say one thing and do another.
Teases blaming tools for lack of skill.

forms: बंदर क्या जाने अदरक का स्वाद
bandar kya jaane adrak ka swaad
entries.translate_as: what does a monkey know of ginger's taste
entries.note: Says fine things are wasted on those who can't value them.
Hushes boasters: empty vessels make most noise.
Warns distant things look better than they are.

entries.translate_as: where there's a will, there's a way
entries.note: Encouragement to keep trying; will finds a way.

entries.translate_as: better late than never, if correct
entries.note: Forgives lateness: better late than never.

forms: अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत
ab pachhtaye hot kya jab chidiya chug gayi khet
entries.translate_as: what use repenting when birds have eaten the field
entries.note: No use crying after the chance is eaten up.

forms: जल में रहकर मगर से बैर
jal mein rehkar magar se bair
entries.translate_as: living in water, don't feud with the crocodile
entries.note: Warns don't fight the power you live under.

forms: लातों के भूत बातों से नहीं मानते
laaton ke bhoot baaton se nahi mante
entries.translate_as: some ghosts only listen to kicks, not words
entries.note: Gruff joke that some stubborn folks only learn the hard way.
Calls out cheeky blame-shifting by the guilty.

entries.translate_as: a straw in the thief's beard — guilt shows
entries.note: Says the guilty betray themselves by nervousness.

entries.translate_as: do good and throw it in the river
entries.note: Teaches selfless good: do good and forget it.

forms: मन चंगा तो कठौती में गंगा
man changa to kathauti mein ganga
mun changa to kathauti me ganga
entries.translate_as: if heart is pure, Ganga is in your tub
entries.note: Purity of heart matters more than pilgrimage.

entries.translate_as: if there's life, there's the world
entries.note: Health-first blessing: life itself is the world.

forms: सब्र का फल मीठा होता है
sabr ka phal meetha hota hai
entries.note: Comforts waiting children: patience tastes sweet.

forms: भगवान के घर देर है अंधेर नहीं
bhagwan ke ghar der hai andher nahi
entries.translate_as: God delays but never denies justice
entries.note: Faith that justice comes late but surely comes.

entries.translate_as: as the company, so the colour
entries.note: Warns friends colour you; choose company well.

forms: बूंद बूंद से सागर भरता है

entries.translate_as: drop by drop fills the ocean
entries.note: Praise for small savings and steady effort.
Family motto for sticking together in trouble.

forms: धीरे धीरे रे मना धीरे सब कुछ होय

Delighted wow for good news, food, or praise.
